prompt: The attached image is a 216x216 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(216,216,false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-108,108,108,-108,0.1,1200);
ref.position.set(0,108,450);
ref.lookAt(0,108,0);

const TAU = Math.PI*2;
const clamp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const mix = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const color = hex => new THREE.Color(hex);
const point = (x,y,z) => new THREE.Vector3(x-108,216-y,z);

function group(parent,name) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function seedRandom(seed) {
  return () => {
    seed = (Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;
    return seed/4294967296;
  };
}
const rand = seedRandom(92413);
const backdrop = document.createElement('canvas');
backdrop.width = backdrop.height = 64;
const ctx = backdrop.getContext('2d');
const pixels = ctx.createImageData(64,64);
for(let y=0;y<64;y++) for(let x=0;x<64;x++) {
  const v=y/63, u=x/63;
  const floor = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(v,.78,1);
  const shade = floor*(20+18*Math.exp(-((u-.55)**2)/.13));
  const grain = (rand()-.5)*2+.9*Math.sin(17*u+9*v);
  const i=4*(y*64+x);
  pixels.data[i]=249-shade+grain;
  pixels.data[i+1]=250-shade+grain;
  pixels.data[i+2]=247-shade+grain;
  pixels.data[i+3]=255;
}
ctx.putImageData(pixels,0,0);
const background = new THREE.CanvasTexture(backdrop);
background.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
scene.background=background;

const coatData = new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
for(let i=0;i<coatData.length;i+=4){
  const n=241+Math.floor(rand()*15);
  coatData[i]=coatData[i+1]=coatData[i+2]=n;
  coatData[i+3]=255;
}
const fleck=new THREE.DataTexture(coatData,64,64);
fleck.wrapS=fleck.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
fleck.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
fleck.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipMapLinearFilter;
fleck.generateMipmaps=true;
fleck.needsUpdate=true;
const skin=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors:true,map:fleck,roughness:.96,side:THREE.DoubleSide
});
const velvet = hex => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color:hex,roughness:.94,side:THREE.DoubleSide
});
const palmMat=velvet(0x53412e);
const fingerMat=velvet(0x493a2b);
const browMat=velvet(0x382416);
const ivory= new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color:0xffedc7, roughness:.55, side:THREE.DoubleSide
});
const creature=group(scene,'laughing-golden-creature');

function gridMesh(parent,name,rows,material,paint,reverse=false) {
  const p=[],c=[],uv=[],idx=[];
  const n=rows[0].length;
  rows.forEach((row,j)=>{
    row.forEach((v,i)=>{
      p.push(v.x,v.y,v.z);
      if(paint) {
        const tint=paint(j,i,v);
        c.push(tint.r,tint.g,tint.b);
      }
      uv.push(i/n*4,j/(rows.length-1)*3);
      if(j<rows.length-1){
        const a=j*n+i,b=j*n+(i+1)%n,d=a+n,e=b+n;
        if(reverse) idx.push(a,d,b,b,d,e);
        else idx.push(a,b,d,b,e,d);
      }
    });
  });
  const geom=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geom.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));
  geom.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  if(paint) geom.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(c,3));
  geom.setIndex(idx);
  geom.computeVertexNormals();
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geom,material);
  m.name=name;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}
function cubic(a,b,c,d,t) {
  return b+.5*t*(c-a+t*(2*a-5*b+4*c-d+t*(3*(b-c)+d-a)));
}
function sample(keys,u) {
  const s=Math.min(u,1)*(keys.length-1);
  const i=Math.min(keys.length-2,Math.floor(s));
  return keys[i].map((v,k)=>cubic(
    keys[Math.max(0,i-1)][k],v,keys[i+1][k],
    keys[Math.min(keys.length-1,i+2)][k],s-i
  ));
}
const honey=color(0xe7b72d), sun=color(0xefcf44), amber=color(0xc68a31);
const belly=color(0xdeaf7f);
function fur(y) {
  return sun.clone().lerp(honey,THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y,26,119))
    .lerp(amber,THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y,123,222)*.88);
}
// Each horizontal section specifies center, depth, and the two radii.
function loft(parent,name,keys,material=skin,paint=null,n=72,steps=null) {
  const count=steps || (keys.length-1)*6, rows=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=count;j++) {
    const [x,y,z,rx,rz]=sample(keys,j/count);
    rows.push(Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>{
      const a=TAU*i/n;
      return point(x+Math.max(.008,rx)*Math.cos(a),y,z+Math.max(.008,rz)*Math.sin(a));
    }));
  }
  return gridMesh(parent,name,rows,material,material===skin ?
    (j,i,v)=>paint ? paint(216-v.y,TAU*i/n,v) : fur(216-v.y) : null);
}

const torso=group(creature,'hunched-torso');
loft(torso,'chest-abdomen-and-rump',[
  [121,43,-6,.02,.02],[121,47,-7,20,12],[120,55,-7,31,19],
  [120,68,-7,39,26],[120,87,-6,43,30],[121,109,-5,43,32],
  [122,128,-4,42,33],[122,145,-4,40,31],[122,158,-5,37,28],
  [122,169,-7,31,24],[122,179,-9,21,16],[122,184,-9,9,8],
  [122,185,-9,.02,.02]
],skin,(y,a,v)=>{
  const da=Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-1.85),Math.cos(a-1.85));
  const dy=(y-139-.14*(v.x+1))/30.5;
  const d=Math.sqrt((da/1.25)**2+dy**2);
  const patch=1-THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(d,.984,1.018);
  return fur(y).lerp(belly,patch);
},208,184);

function leg(name,keys) {
  const g=group(creature,name);
  loft(g,'thigh-knee-and-lower-leg',keys);
}
leg('leg-image-left',[
  [103,154,-9,.03,.03],[103,160,-9,14,14],[101,171,-7,20,20],

const leftArm=group(creature,'arm-image-left');
loft(leftArm,'sloping-shoulder-and-arm',[

  [80,78,-4,13,14],[77.7,94,-2,12.6,14],[77,109,1,11.3,12.7],
  [78.7,127,4,10,11],[82.2,146,7,9.8,10.8],[85.1,159,11,8.6,9.6],
  [88,168.5,15,7.5,8.2],[88.5,175,16,6.3,6.8],[88.6,178,16,.02,.02]
]);
const rightArm=group(creature,'arm-image-right');
loft(rightArm,'heavy-shoulder-and-forearm',[
  [144,52,-13,.03,.03],[149,55,-13,7,8],[153,63,-12,11,13],
  [158,75,-10,14.4,16],[163,88,-7,16.7,19],[168,101,-2,18.7,21],
  [170.8,114,2,21.3,22.4],[172.7,129,5,23.6,23.6],
  [172.3,142,8,23.4,23],[170.2,154,11,21.6,21],
  [166.8,165,15,18.7,18.4],[163.8,174,18,14.5,15],
  [162.6,180,19,10.8,12.8],[162,184,19,.03,.03]

// Tapered volumes follow the fingers around the fronts of the knees.
function digit(g,name,p,r=1) {
  const keys=p.map(([x,y,z,w])=>[x,y,z,w*r,w*r*.94]);
  return loft(g,name,keys,fingerMat,null,24);
}
const lh=group(leftArm,'left-hand');
loft(lh,'palm',[

],palmMat);
digit(lh,'outside-finger',[[81.4,178,19,.2],[81,181,20,2.35],[80,186,20.7,2.2],[79,191,20,1.85],[79.3,193.4,19,.15]]);
digit(lh,'middle-finger',[[84,180,22,.2],[83.4,183,23,2.25],[82.3,189,23.5,2.15],[82,194,22.7,1.85],[82.5,196.3,21.7,.12]]);
digit(lh,'index-finger',[[87.7,180,22,.2],[87.5,184,23,2.35],[86.8,190,24,2.1],[87,194.2,22.7,1.7],[87.5,196,21,.1]]);
digit(lh,'thumb',[[90.5,172.5,19,.1],[92,175.1,20,2.8],[94,179.5,20.5,2.45],[96.8,182.7,20,2.1],[97.7,185.5,18.6,.12]]);

const rh=group(rightArm,'right-hand');
loft(rh,'palm',[
  [161.5,173,22,.03,.03],[160.2,175.2,24,7.3,5.7],
  [159.8,179.6,26,10.1,6.5],[159,184.7,27,9.5,6.1],
  [158.7,188,27.8,7.2,4.8],[159,190.5,27.6,.1,.1]
],palmMat);
digit(rh,'thumb',[[154.8,177,25,.1],[151.9,179.5,27,3.3],[148.7,184,28.9,3],[145.9,188.8,29.2,2.35],[145.4,192,28.3,1.4],[146,193,27.3,.1]]);
digit(rh,'index-finger',[[152.5,182.4,28,.1],[151.7,186,30.1,2.9],[150.2,192,31,2.6],[150.3,197.8,29.7,2.05],[151,200.1,28,.1]]);
digit(rh,'middle-finger',[[157.2,184.2,30,.1],[156.8,187.7,32.3,2.95],[156.5,194,32.7,2.7],[157.7,199.5,31,2.15],[158.5,201.6,29.2,.1]]);
digit(rh,'ring-finger',[[162.2,183.4,29,.1],[162,187.3,31.5,2.8],[163.2,192.3,31.8,2.45],[165.7,196.3,30.6,1.9],[166.8,197.6,28.7,.1]]);
digit(rh,'little-finger',[[166.3,181.4,26,.1],[167.4,184.8,28,2.5],[169.7,189.1,28.8,2.2],[172.1,192.4,27.9,1.7],[173.2,193.6,26.4,.1]]);

const head=group(creature,'upturned-head');
const face=group(head,'face');
const mouth=group(head,'open-laughing-mouth');
const eyes=group(head,'squeezed-eyes');
const ox=116,oy=50;
function outline(points) {
  const spline=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(([x,y])=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,0)),true,'centripetal');
  return spline.getPoints(360);
}
const skull=outline([
  [122,12.1],[133,14.2],[143.6,21.3],[149.5,32],[151.2,44.7],
  [150.5,54],[145.5,66.5],[137,77.5],[125.5,84.1],[113,84],
  [101,77.4],[94.2,68],[91.6,56],[92.4,43],[96,30],[101.8,20.5],[111,14.2]
]);
const opening=outline([
  [101.7,32.8],[106.2,32.4],[114.2,33.7],[123.2,36],
  [132.8,39.2],[137.9,41.6],[136.7,45.1],[132.4,52.8],
  [126.1,61.9],[119.1,68.9],[113.1,71.3],[107.5,70.2],
  [103.4,66.3],[101,60.2],[100.1,51.3],[100.4,40]
]);
function radius(path,dx,dy) {
  let nearest=1e4;
  for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++) {
    const a=path[i-1],b=path[i],sx=b.x-a.x,sy=b.y-a.y;
    const det=dx*sy-dy*sx;
    if(Math.abs(det)<1e-7)continue;
    const ax=a.x-ox,ay=a.y-oy;
    const r=(ax*sy-ay*sx)/det,t=(ax*dy-ay*dx)/det;
    if(r>0 && t>=0 && t<=1)nearest=Math.min(nearest,r);
  }
  return nearest;
}
function skullDepth(x,y,r,R) {
  return 8.5-.13*(x-119)-.065*(y-45)+24.2*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(r/R)**2));
}
const N=128;
const rays=Array.from({length:N},(_,i)=>{
  const a=TAU*i/N,dx=Math.cos(a),dy=Math.sin(a);
  return {dx,dy,R:radius(skull,dx,dy),m:radius(opening,dx,dy)};
});
const rows=[],tints=[];
const goldenFace=color(0xeaca43),chin=color(0xe2ad4d),lip=color(0xdbac69);
for(let j=0;j<=48;j++){
  const u=j/48;
  const row=[],tint=[];
  for(const {dx,dy,R,m} of rays){
    const r=m+(R-m)*Math.sin(u*Math.PI/2);
    const x=ox+r*dx,y=oy+r*dy,dist=r-m;
    const lipWidth=dy>.05?4.7:2.3;
    const pad=Math.exp(-(dist**2)/(2*lipWidth**2));
    const z=skullDepth(x,y,r,R)+pad*(dy>.1?3:1.7);
    row.push(point(x,y,z));
    tint.push(goldenFace.clone().lerp(chin,THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y,45,85)*.75)
      .lerp(lip,pad*(.50+.23*dy)));
  }
  rows.push(row);tints.push(tint);
}
gridMesh(face,'cheeks-muzzle-and-forehead',rows,skin,(j,i)=>tints[j][i]);
const backRows=[];
for(let j=0;j<=48;j++) {
  const a=j/48*Math.PI/2;
  backRows.push(rays.map(({dx,dy,R})=>{
    const r=R*Math.cos(a),x=ox+dx*r,y=oy+dy*r;
    return point(x,y,8.5-.13*(x-119)-.065*(y-45)-25.2*Math.sin(a));
  }));
}
gridMesh(head,'back-of-skull',backRows,skin,(j,i,v)=>fur(216-v.y));

const cavity=[],cavityColors=[];
const innerLip=color(0x75452c),throat=color(0x170c09),deep=color(0x0d0807);
for(let j=0;j<=40;j++){
  const u=j/40,row=[],cols=[];
  for(const {dx,dy,R,m} of rays){
    const r=m*(1-u),x=ox+r*dx,y=oy+r*dy;
    const edge=skullDepth(ox+m*dx,oy+m*dy,m,R)+(dy>.1?3:1.7);
    const z=edge-12*Math.sin(u*Math.PI/2)**.76-2*u;
    row.push(point(x,y,z));
    cols.push(innerLip.clone().lerp(throat,THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(m*u,0,2.1))
      .lerp(deep,THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(u,.12,.8)));
  }
  cavity.push(row);cavityColors.push(cols);
}
const cavityMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:1,side:THREE.DoubleSide});
gridMesh(mouth,'recessed-mouth-interior',cavity,cavityMat,(j,i)=>cavityColors[j][i],true);

function faceZ(x,y) {
  const r=Math.hypot(x-ox,y-oy)||.001,dx=(x-ox)/r,dy=(y-oy)/r;
  return skullDepth(x,y,r,radius(skull,dx,dy));
}
// Swept ellipses give the shut eyelids a soft ridge and a narrow crease.
function ridge(parent,name,keys,material) {
  const rows=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=36;j++) {
    const u=j/36,[x,y,w,d,offset]=sample(keys,u);
    const a=sample(keys,Math.max(0,u-.001)),b=sample(keys,Math.min(1,u+.001));
    const length=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1;
    const nx=-(b[1]-a[1])/length,ny=(b[0]-a[0])/length;
    const z=faceZ(x,y)+offset;
    rows.push(Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>{
      const angle=i*TAU/16,k=Math.cos(angle)*Math.max(.01,w);
      return point(x+nx*k,y+ny*k,z+Math.sin(angle)*d);
    }));
  }
  return gridMesh(parent,name,rows,material,null,true);
}
function lid(name,knots) {
  const g=group(eyes,name);
  ridge(g,'golden-lid',knots.map(([x,y,w])=>[x,y+.8,w*1.35,.95,.36]),velvet(0xdcb744));
  ridge(g,'dark-eyelid-crease',knots.map(([x,y,w])=>[x,y,w,1,.95]),browMat);
}
lid('eye-image-left',[[100.4,23.8,.04],[101.8,20.1,.97],[104.3,18.8,1.56],
  [107.4,19.1,1.5],[110.5,20.9,.83],[112.5,22.6,.04]]);
lid('eye-image-right',[[132.8,29,.04],[135.4,26.9,1.12],[138.6,27,1.65],
  [142,28.6,1.54],[144.9,31.1,1.02],[146.1,33.9,.05]]);

function edgeZ(x,y) {
  const d=Math.hypot(x-ox,y-oy),dx=(x-ox)/d,dy=(y-oy)/d;
  const r=radius(opening,dx,dy);
  return skullDepth(ox+r*dx,oy+r*dy,r,radius(skull,dx,dy))+(dy>.1?3:1.7);
}
const teeth=group(mouth,'teeth');
function tooth(name,x,y,width,height,angle,upper,tint=ivory) {
  const g=group(teeth,name);
  g.position.copy(point(x,y,edgeZ(x,y)-1.15));
  g.rotation.z=-angle;
  const dir=upper?-1:1;
  const shape=new THREE.Shape(),w=width*.5;
  shape.moveTo(-w*.86,-dir*.9);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-w*1.08,dir*height*.33,-w*.82,dir*height*.82);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-w*.58,dir*height*1.02,0,dir*height);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(w*.71,dir*height*1.02,w*.85,dir*height*.78);
  shape.lineTo(w,-dir*.8);
  shape.closePath();
  const geo=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth:.72,bevelEnabled:true,
    bevelSegments:3,steps:1,bevelSize:.29,bevelThickness:.32,curveSegments:5});
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,tint);
  mesh.name='rounded-enamel';g.add(mesh);
}
[
  [107.1,33.8,3.05,5.9,.05],[110.7,34.2,3.85,3.05,.16],
  [114.7,34.9,4.1,2.8,.23],[118.9,35.9,4.3,2.65,.28],
  [123.2,37.1,4.25,2.55,.30],[127.3,38.5,3.82,2.6,.34],
  [130.9,39.8,3.35,2.8,.36],[133.7,40.9,2.3,3.5,.44]
].forEach((p,i)=>tooth('upper-tooth-'+(i+1),...p,true));
[

  [112.2,67.65,3.2,2.45,.08],[115.3,67.5,3.2,2.35,-.16],
  [118.2,66.3,2.85,2.55,-.38],[120.6,64.9,2.1,2.25,-.55]
].forEach((p,i)=>tooth('lower-tooth-'+(i+1),...p,false));

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff9e9,0xd6b79f,1.48));
